```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
```

Reproduces every number, table, and figure in the main text from the files in `../data` and the two coding workbooks in
`../Manual Coding Checks`. Knit from the `analysis` folder; figures are saved to `figures/`. The analyses reported only in
the supplement are in `AIO_Overviews_Supplement.R`.

**Robustness check.** To rerun every analysis on single-turn questions of 44 words or fewer (the Results paragraph on
short single-turn questions and Table S12), uncomment the second line below and knit again. Figures are then saved with
the suffix `_short`.

```{r toggle}
SHORT_ONLY <- FALSE
# SHORT_ONLY <- TRUE    # robustness check: single-turn questions of 44 words or fewer
```

# Setup

```{r packages}
library(dplyr); library(tidyr); library(tibble); library(readr); library(stringr); library(purrr)
library(readxl); library(knitr); library(ggplot2)
```

```{r paths}
DATA   <- "../data"
MANUAL <- "../Manual Coding Checks"
FIG    <- "figures"
coding_sheet <- function(pattern) {
  f <- list.files(MANUAL, pattern, full.names = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
  f <- f[!startsWith(basename(f), "~$")]
  if (length(f) != 1) stop("Put the one workbook matching '", pattern, "' in ", MANUAL)
  f }
HAL_HUMAN <- coding_sheet("HallOumi.*\\.xlsx$")     # statement support: human coders and HallOumi
JH_HUMAN  <- coding_sheet("JAMA.*HON.*\\.xlsx$")    # JAMA and HONcode: human coders
dir.create(FIG, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
LV <- c("Low", "Medium", "High"); B_REPS <- 2000; SEED <- 0
CRIT <- c("JAMA_Authorship", "JAMA_Attribution", "JAMA_Disclosure", "JAMA_Currency", "HON_Authority", "HON_Complementarity")
rd     <- function(f) read_csv(file.path(DATA, f), guess_max = 1e6, show_col_types = FALSE, na = c("", "NA", "nan", "NaN", "None"))
r1     <- function(x, d = 1) round(x, d)
msd    <- function(x) c(n = sum(!is.na(x)), M = mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), SD = sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), Mdn = median(x, na.rm = TRUE),
                        min = min(x, na.rm = TRUE), max = max(x, na.rm = TRUE))
paired <- function(a, o) { d <- a - o; t <- t.test(a, o, paired = TRUE)
  c(n = length(d), M_aio = mean(a), SD_aio = sd(a), M_org = mean(o), SD_org = sd(o), t = unname(t$statistic),
    df = unname(t$parameter), p = t$p.value, dz = mean(d) / sd(d), dz_lo = t$conf.int[1] / sd(d), dz_hi = t$conf.int[2] / sd(d)) }
boot   <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; set.seed(SEED)
  b <- replicate(B_REPS, mean(sample(x, replace = TRUE)))
  c(n = length(x), est = mean(x), lo = unname(quantile(b, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(b, .975))) }
clip   <- function(x) pmin(pmax(x, 0), 1)
wilson <- function(k, n) { z <- 1.96; p <- k / n; m <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / (1 + z^2 / n)
  h <- z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z^2 / (4 * n^2)) / (1 + z^2 / n); c(n = n, k = k, est = p, lo = m - h, hi = m + h) }
kappa  <- function(a, b) { po <- mean(a == b); pe <- mean(a) * mean(b) + (1 - mean(a)) * (1 - mean(b)); (po - pe) / (1 - pe) }
kci    <- function(a, b) {        # agreement, Cohen's kappa with asymptotic 95% CI, exact McNemar test (binary codes)
  t <- table(factor(a, 0:1), factor(b, 0:1)) / length(a); r <- rowSums(t); c <- colSums(t)
  po <- sum(diag(t)); pe <- sum(r * c); k <- (po - pe) / (1 - pe)
  A1 <- sum(diag(t) * (1 - (r + c) * (1 - k))^2); B1 <- (1 - k)^2 * (t[1, 2] * (c[1] + r[2])^2 + t[2, 1] * (c[2] + r[1])^2)
  se <- unname(sqrt((A1 + B1 - (k - pe * (1 - k))^2) / length(a)) / (1 - pe))
  c(n = length(a), agree = r1(100 * po), kappa = round(k, 2), lo = round(k - 1.96 * se, 2), hi = round(min(1, k + 1.96 * se), 2),
    human_supported = r1(100 * mean(a)), halloumi_supported = r1(100 * mean(b)),
    h1_m0 = sum(a == 1 & b == 0), h0_m1 = sum(a == 0 & b == 1),
    mcnemar_p = signif(binom.test(sum(a == 1 & b == 0), sum(a != b))$p.value, 3)) }
holm_pairs <- function(by) combn(LV, 2, simplify = FALSE) %>% map_dfr(function(pr) {   # by: lvl, n, k
  a <- by[by$lvl == pr[1], ]; b <- by[by$lvl == pr[2], ]
  tt <- suppressWarnings(prop.test(c(a$k, b$k), c(a$n, b$n), correct = FALSE))
  tibble(level_1 = pr[1], level_2 = pr[2], chisq = unname(tt$statistic), p = tt$p.value) }) %>%
  mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm"))
```

Figure style (as in the paper: Arial, 95% CIs, white background).

```{r figure_style}
PAL  <- c(AIO = "#2a78d6", Organic = "#eb6834"); FONT <- "Arial"; ERR <- 1.96
minus <- function(s) gsub("-", "−", s, fixed = TRUE)
f_int <- function(x) formatC(x, format = "d", big.mark = ",")
f_num <- function(x, d) minus(formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "***", ifelse(p < .01, "**", ifelse(p < .05, "*", "")))
n_lab <- function(l, n) paste0(l, "<br>(*n* = ", f_int(n), ")")
theme_ms <- function(base = 11) theme_classic(base_size = base, base_family = FONT) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = .4), axis.ticks = element_line(colour = "black", linewidth = .4),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = "black"), axis.title = element_text(colour = "black"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(), plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = rel(1.4)),
        plot.margin = margin(10, 16, 8, 8))
save_fig <- function(p, name, w, h) {         # 600-dpi PNG and vector PDF
  name <- paste0(name, if (SHORT_ONLY) "_short" else "")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG, paste0(name, ".png")), p, width = w, height = h, dpi = 600, bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png)
  ggsave(file.path(FIG, paste0(name, ".pdf")), p, width = w, height = h, bg = "white", device = grDevices::cairo_pdf)
  p }
# Bars of a rate by level with 95% CIs and Holm-adjusted pairwise chi-square brackets (Figures 1 and 5).
# by: lvl, n, k (events), p, se; top: the highest CI end across both panels, so they share a y-axis.
plot_rate <- function(by, pw, xlab, ylab, tag, top) {
  step <- top * .13; xpos <- setNames(seq_along(LV), LV)
  br <- pw %>% mutate(x1 = xpos[level_1], x2 = xpos[level_2],
                      y = top + step * c(1.7, 2.7, 3.7)[match(paste(level_1, level_2), c("Low Medium", "Medium High", "Low High"))],
                      lab = ifelse(p_holm < .05, stars(p_holm), "ns"))
  tick <- step * .22
  ggplot(by, aes(lvl, p)) +
    geom_col(width = .6, fill = PAL[["AIO"]]) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(0, p - ERR * se), ymax = p + ERR * se), width = .16, linewidth = .45) +
    geom_text(aes(y = p + ERR * se + top * .035, label = paste0(f_num(100 * p, 1), "%")), vjust = 0, family = FONT, size = 3.6) +
    geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x1, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .4) +
    geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x1, xend = x1, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .4) +
    geom_segment(data = br, aes(x = x2, xend = x2, y = y, yend = y - tick), inherit.aes = FALSE, linewidth = .4) +
    geom_text(data = br, aes(x = (x1 + x2) / 2, y = y + step * .06, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0,
              family = FONT, size = 4) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = function(l) n_lab(l, by$n[match(l, by$lvl)])) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(round(100 * x), "%"), limits = c(0, top + step * 4.4),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))) +
    labs(x = xlab, y = ylab, tag = tag) +
    theme_ms() + theme(axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(colour = "black", lineheight = 1.15))
}
```

# Data

The analysed questions (all but the 241 excluded) and, for the robustness check, the short single-turn subset. Then
the two quality gates: overviews with at least 200 characters of text (gate 1) and pages with readable text (gate 2).
The paired sample has readable pages in both arms.

```{r data}
QS <- rd("questions.csv") %>% filter(excluded == 0)
if (SHORT_ONLY) QS <- QS %>% filter(n_user_turns == 1, !has_assistant_turns, q_words <= 44)
keep <- function(d) d[d$q_index %in% QS$q_index, ]
Q  <- keep(rd("overviews.csv")) %>% mutate(aio_present = as.logical(aio_present))
S  <- keep(rd("sources.csv")) %>% mutate(text_quality = coalesce(text_quality, ""))
ST <- keep(rd("statements.csv"))
good <- Q$q_index[Q$aio_present & !is.na(Q$aio_text_len) & Q$aio_text_len >= 200]                 # gate 1
R  <- S %>% filter(q_index %in% good, text_quality == "ok", !is.na(text_len), text_len > 0)     # gate 2
pq <- R %>% distinct(q_index, source_type) %>% count(q_index) %>% filter(n == 2) %>% pull(q_index)
lv <- QS %>% select(q_index, risk_level, rubric_complexity)
c(questions = nrow(QS), aio_returned = sum(Q$aio_present), gate1 = length(good), paired = length(pq))
```

# Methods

## Questions (Table 1) and searches

Questions by risk level and rubric complexity, question length in words, and the searches captured.

```{r sample}
addmargins(table(Risk = factor(QS$risk_level, LV), Complexity = factor(QS$rubric_complexity, LV)))
round(msd(QS$q_words), 1)
SE <- keep(rd("searches.csv")); err <- coalesce(SE$error, "")
failed <- grepl("serpapi_error|question_exception|aio_prefetch_failed", err, ignore.case = TRUE)
c(submitted = nrow(SE), failed = sum(failed), captured = sum(!failed), aio_returned = sum(Q$aio_present),
  pct_returned = r1(100 * sum(Q$aio_present) / sum(!failed)))
```

## JAMA and HONcode coding against human coders

One human code per page (the worksheet keeps one coder's codes on the pages that all three coders coded) against the
automated code, pooled over the six criteria. Table S7 (supplement) breaks this down by criterion.

```{r jama_hon_human}
auto <- rd("jama_hon_validation.csv") %>% select(url, all_of(CRIT))
hum_all <- read_excel(JH_HUMAN, sheet = "Coding Worksheet _Human") %>% filter(!is.na(url)) %>% mutate(url = str_trim(url)) %>%
  filter(!grepl("google\\.com/searchviewer|facebook\\.com", url, ignore.case = TRUE)) %>% select(Coder, url, all_of(CRIT)) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(CRIT), ~ suppressWarnings(as.numeric(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(all_of(CRIT), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "human") %>% filter(!is.na(human))
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(hum_all[c("url", "criterion")]))          # one human code per page and criterion
hum <- hum_all %>% inner_join(auto %>% pivot_longer(all_of(CRIT), names_to = "criterion", values_to = "auto"), by = c("url", "criterion"))
hum %>% summarise(judgments = n(), pages = n_distinct(url), agreement = r1(100 * mean(human == auto)), kappa = round(kappa(human, auto), 2))
```

## HallOumi against human coders

The 100 validation statements: two coders (60 and 40 statements) and HallOumi, each judging whether the cited pages
support the statement.

```{r halloumi_human}
SUP <- "Supported? (1 = supported, 0 = not supported)"
VKEY <- c("Item", "Question ID", "Statement # in overview", "AI Overview statement being judged")
hv <- read_excel(HAL_HUMAN, sheet = "Human Coding", col_types = "text") %>% select(all_of(VKEY), Coder, human = all_of(SUP)) %>%
  inner_join(read_excel(HAL_HUMAN, sheet = "HallOumi Coding", col_types = "text") %>% select(all_of(VKEY), halloumi = all_of(SUP)), by = VKEY) %>%
  mutate(across(c(human, halloumi), ~ as.integer(str_trim(.x))))
stopifnot(nrow(hv) == 100, all(hv$human %in% 0:1), all(hv$halloumi %in% 0:1))
kci(hv$human, hv$halloumi)
```

## Physician rubrics and the GPT-4.1 grader

Each overview's HealthBench rubric criteria and GPT-4.1's verdict on each. Overviews are scored as in HealthBench:
points earned divided by the maximum positive points (overall, per axis, for accuracy and completeness together, and
for consensus criteria), plus three rates.

```{r rubric_data}
items  <- keep(rd("rubric_items.csv"))
grades <- rd("grades_gpt41.csv") %>% select(prompt_id, item_idx, met = criteria_met)
g <- items %>% inner_join(grades, by = c("prompt_id", "item_idx")) %>%
  left_join(QS %>% select(q_index, theme, risk = risk_level, cx = rubric_complexity, multi = has_assistant_turns), by = "q_index")
sc <- function(p, m) if (sum(p[p > 0]) == 0) NA_real_ else sum(p[m]) / sum(p[p > 0])
A <-g %>% group_by(q_index, prompt_id, theme, risk, cx, multi) %>% summarise(
  overall = sc(points, met), clinical = sc(points[axis %in% c("accuracy", "completeness")], met[axis %in% c("accuracy", "completeness")]),
  accuracy = sc(points[axis == "accuracy"], met[axis == "accuracy"]),
  completeness = sc(points[axis == "completeness"], met[axis == "completeness"]),
  context_awareness = sc(points[axis == "context_awareness"], met[axis == "context_awareness"]),
  communication_quality = sc(points[axis == "communication_quality"], met[axis == "communication_quality"]),
  instruction_following = sc(points[axis == "instruction_following"], met[axis == "instruction_following"]),
  consensus = sc(points[level == "cluster"], met[level == "cluster"]),
  harm = if (any(points < 0 & axis == "accuracy")) any(met[points < 0 & axis == "accuracy"]) else NA,
  acc_check = if (any(accuracy_check)) met[accuracy_check][1] else NA,
  emergency = if (any(emergency_behavior)) met[emergency_behavior][1] else NA, .groups = "drop")
n_per <- count(g, prompt_id)
c(overviews = nrow(A), criteria = nrow(g), median_per_overview = median(n_per$n),
  to_avoid = sum(g$points < 0), pct_to_avoid = r1(100 * mean(g$points < 0)))
```

Grader validation on HealthBench's meta-evaluation: macro-F1 of GPT-4.1 against every physician grade on the 3,000
sampled rows, and the physician benchmark on the same rows (each physician against the other physicians, weighted by
their number of grades), using simple-evals' pairwise definition.

```{r grader_validation}
me  <- rd("meta_eval_gpt41.csv")
lab <- map(strsplit(me$physician_labels, ";"), ~ as.logical(as.integer(.x)))
ids <- strsplit(me$physician_ids, ";")
mf1 <- function(self, other) {        # pairs of (rater, other grader); macro-F1 over met / not met
  ag <- self == other
  f1 <- function(s) { p <- mean(ag[self == s]); r <- mean(ag[other == s]); if (is.na(p) || is.na(r)) NA else if (p + r == 0) 0 else 2 * p * r / (p + r) }
  (f1(TRUE) + f1(FALSE)) / 2 }
pairs_model <- map2_dfr(me$gpt41_met, lab, ~ tibble(self = .x, other = .y))
phys <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(me)), function(i) { l <- lab[[i]]; id <- ids[[i]]
  map_dfr(seq_along(l), function(j) tibble(pid = id[j], self = l[j], other = l[-j])) })
pm <- phys %>% group_by(pid) %>% summarise(mf1 = mf1(self, other)) %>% filter(!is.na(mf1)) %>%
  left_join(count(tibble(pid = unlist(ids)), pid, name = "n"), by = "pid")
c(rows = nrow(me), gpt41_mf1 = round(mf1(pairs_model$self, pairs_model$other), 3), physicians_mf1 = round(weighted.mean(pm$mf1, pm$n), 3))
```

# Results

## Analytic sample (Table 2)

```{r table2}
QA <- Q %>% filter(aio_present) %>% mutate(uncited = n_aio_sources == 0 | is.na(n_aio_sources)) %>%
  left_join(QS %>% select(q_index, q_words), by = "q_index")
rbind(aio_words = msd(QA$aio_text_words), sources_aio = msd(QA$n_aio_sources),
      sources_aio_citing = msd(QA$n_aio_sources[!QA$uncited]), sources_organic = msd(QA$n_organic)) %>% round(2)
c(cited = sum(!QA$uncited), uncited = sum(QA$uncited), pct_uncited = r1(100 * mean(QA$uncited)),
  organic_5 = sum(QA$n_organic >= 5), organic_4_or_fewer = sum(QA$n_organic < 5))
```

## Uncited overviews (Figure 1)

Question length of uncited and cited overviews (Welch t test, pooled-SD Cohen's d), uncited rates by complexity and
risk (Cochran–Armitage trend tests), and Holm-adjusted pairwise tests (the brackets in Figure 1).

```{r uncited}
u <- QA$q_words[QA$uncited]; k <- QA$q_words[!QA$uncited]; wt <- t.test(u, k)
sp <- sqrt(((length(u) - 1) * var(u) + (length(k) - 1) * var(k)) / (length(u) + length(k) - 2))
c(M_uncited = mean(u), SD_uncited = sd(u), M_cited = mean(k), SD_cited = sd(k),
  t = unname(wt$statistic), df = unname(wt$parameter), p = wt$p.value, d = (mean(u) - mean(k)) / sp) %>% signif(4)
unc <- map(c(rubric_complexity = "rubric_complexity", risk_level = "risk_level"), function(v) {
  by <- QA %>% filter(.data[[v]] %in% LV) %>% group_by(lvl = factor(.data[[v]], LV)) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), k = sum(uncited), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(p = k / n, se = sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n))
  list(by = by, pw = holm_pairs(by), trend = prop.trend.test(by$k, by$n)) })
for (v in names(unc)) {
  print(kable(unc[[v]]$by %>% mutate(pct = r1(100 * p)) %>% select(lvl, n, uncited = k, pct), caption = v))
  print(kable(unc[[v]]$pw %>% mutate(across(c(chisq, p, p_holm), ~ signif(.x, 3)))))
  cat(v, ": Cochran-Armitage chi2(1) =", r1(unc[[v]]$trend$statistic, 2), ", p =", signif(unc[[v]]$trend$p.value, 3), "\n")
}
top1 <- max(map_dbl(unc, ~ max(.x$by$p + ERR * .x$by$se)))
YL1 <- "AI Overviews with no citations"
save_fig(plot_rate(unc$rubric_complexity$by, unc$rubric_complexity$pw, "Rubric complexity", YL1, "A", top1), "Figure1A_uncited_by_rubric_complexity", 5.2, 4.6)
save_fig(plot_rate(unc$risk_level$by, unc$risk_level$pw, "Question risk level", YL1, "B", top1), "Figure1B_uncited_by_risk_level", 5.2, 4.6)
```

## Overlap of sources (Figure 2)

Unique question–URL pairs among readable pages: cited by the overview only, by both, or in the organic top five only.

```{r overlap}
ov <- R %>% distinct(q_index, source_type, url) %>% count(q_index, url, name = "arms") %>%
  left_join(R %>% distinct(q_index, url, source_type) %>% filter(source_type == "AIO") %>% transmute(q_index, url, aio = TRUE),
            by = c("q_index", "url"))
V <- c(pairs = nrow(ov), aio_only = sum(ov$arms == 1 & ov$aio %in% TRUE), both = sum(ov$arms == 2),
       organic_only = sum(ov$arms == 1 & is.na(ov$aio)))
c(V, aio_total = V[["aio_only"]] + V[["both"]], organic_total = V[["both"]] + V[["organic_only"]],
  pct_organic_shared = r1(100 * V[["both"]] / (V[["both"]] + V[["organic_only"]])),
  pct_organic_only = r1(100 * V[["organic_only"]] / (V[["both"]] + V[["organic_only"]])))
# area-proportional Venn diagram; percentages are shares of the organic top five
nA <- V[["aio_only"]] + V[["both"]]; nB <- V[["both"]] + V[["organic_only"]]; rA <- sqrt(nA / pi); rB <- sqrt(nB / pi)
lens <- function(d, r1, r2) r1^2 * acos((d^2 + r1^2 - r2^2) / (2 * d * r1)) + r2^2 * acos((d^2 + r2^2 - r1^2) / (2 * d * r2)) -
  .5 * sqrt((-d + r1 + r2) * (d + r1 - r2) * (d - r1 + r2) * (d + r1 + r2))
dAB <- uniroot(function(d) lens(d, rA, rB) - V[["both"]], c(abs(rA - rB) + 1e-6, rA + rB - 1e-6), tol = 1e-10)$root
circ <- function(cx, r, set) { th <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = 721); tibble(x = cx + r * cos(th), y = r * sin(th), set = set) }
cc <- bind_rows(circ(0, rA, "AIO"), circ(dAB, rB, "Organic"))
pct <- function(n) paste0(f_num(100 * n / nB, 1), "%")
lab_g <- tibble(x = c((-rA + dAB - rB) / 2, (dAB - rB + rA) / 2, (rA + dAB + rB) / 2), y = 0,
                txt = c(paste0("AI Overview only<br>*n* = ", f_int(V[["aio_only"]])),
                        paste0("Both<br>*n* = ", f_int(V[["both"]]), "<br>", pct(V[["both"]])),
                        paste0("Traditional only<br>*n* = ", f_int(V[["organic_only"]]), "<br>", pct(V[["organic_only"]]))))
head_g <- tibble(x = c(0, dAB + rB), y = c(rA, rB) + rA * .07, hj = c(.5, 1), set = c("AIO", "Organic"),
                 txt = c(paste0("**AI Overview citations (*n* = ", f_int(nA), ")**"), paste0("**Traditional top 5 (*n* = ", f_int(nB), ")**")))
save_fig(ggplot() +
  geom_polygon(data = cc, aes(x, y, fill = set, group = set), alpha = .28) +
  geom_path(data = cc, aes(x, y, colour = set, group = set), linewidth = .9) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = lab_g, aes(x, y, label = txt), family = FONT, size = 3.6, lineheight = 1.1, fill = NA, label.colour = NA) +
  ggtext::geom_richtext(data = head_g, aes(x, y, label = txt, colour = set, hjust = hj), family = FONT, size = 3.8, vjust = 0,
                        fill = NA, label.colour = NA, label.padding = grid::unit(0, "pt")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = PAL) + scale_colour_manual(values = PAL) + coord_equal(clip = "off") + theme_void(base_family = FONT) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA), plot.margin = margin(12, 12, 12, 12)),
  "Figure2_aio_organic_url_overlap", 7, 4.6)
```

## Source quality (Figure 3)

Per-question mean JAMA and HONcode scores of the readable pages in each arm, compared with paired t tests
(Benjamini–Hochberg across the six criteria); dz with its 95% CI. Table S10 (supplement) lists the means.

```{r quality}
qm <- R %>% filter(q_index %in% pq) %>% group_by(q_index, source_type) %>%
  summarise(across(c(all_of(CRIT), JAMA_Total, HON_Total), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
arm <- function(v, d = qm) d %>% select(q_index, source_type, all_of(v)) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = source_type, values_from = all_of(v))
qt <- map_dfr(CRIT, ~ { x <- arm(.x); as_tibble_row(paired(x$AIO, x$Organic)) %>% mutate(measure = .x, .before = 1) }) %>%
  mutate(p_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
qt %>% transmute(measure, n, t = round(t, 2), p_BH = signif(p_BH, 3), dz = round(dz, 2), dz_lo = round(dz_lo, 2), dz_hi = round(dz_hi, 2)) %>% kable()
c(differ_after_BH = sum(qt$p_BH < .05), organic_higher = sum(qt$p_BH < .05 & qt$dz < 0))
LABEL <- setNames(sub("_", " ", CRIT), CRIT)
fb <- qt %>% mutate(lab = factor(LABEL[measure], levels = rev(LABEL)),
                    txt = minus(paste0(ifelse(round(dz, 2) == 0, "0.00", sprintf("%+.2f", dz)), " ", stars(p_BH))))
save_fig(ggplot(fb, aes(dz, lab)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey45", linewidth = .4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = dz_lo, xmax = dz_hi), width = .22, linewidth = .6, colour = "black") +
  geom_point(size = 2.6, colour = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(x = .32, label = txt), hjust = 0, family = FONT, size = 3.4) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-.3, .3, .1), labels = function(x) minus(sprintf("%.1f", x))) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-.3, .3), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = expression(paste("Cohen's ", italic(d)[z], " (AI Overview − traditional), 95% CI")), y = NULL) +
  theme_ms() + theme(plot.margin = margin(10, 62, 8, 8), axis.line.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank()),
  "Figure3_jama_honcode_effect_sizes", 7.5, 3.8)
```

The same comparison within each risk level and each rubric complexity level, on the JAMA and HONcode totals
(unadjusted).

```{r quality_levels}
ql <- map_dfr(c("risk_level", "rubric_complexity"), function(v) map_dfr(c("JAMA_Total", "HON_Total"), function(m)
  arm(m) %>% left_join(lv, by = "q_index") %>% group_by(level = .data[[v]]) %>%
```

## Statement grounding (Figures 4 and 5)

Composition of all overview statements and the support rate of statements scorable against a cited page.

```{r statements}
st <- ST %>% filter(q_index %in% good) %>%
  mutate(bucket = case_when(status == "uncited" & uncited_type == "uncited_factual" ~ "uncited factual",
                            status == "uncited" ~ "header or conversational", TRUE ~ status))
st %>% count(bucket) %>% mutate(pct = r1(100 * n / sum(n))) %>% kable()
sco <- st %>% filter(status %in% c("supported", "unsupported"))
c(statements = nrow(st), overviews = n_distinct(st$q_index), scorable = nrow(sco), pct_scorable = r1(100 * nrow(sco) / nrow(st)),
  supported = sum(sco$status == "supported"), not_supported = sum(sco$status == "unsupported"),
  support_rate = r1(100 * mean(sco$status == "supported"), 2))
fj <- st %>% count(bucket) %>% tibble::deframe()
fj <- tibble(part = c("Supported", "Not supported", "Factual, uncited", "Indeterminate", "Headers &\nconversational"),
             n = c(fj[["supported"]], fj[["unsupported"]], fj[["uncited factual"]], fj[["skipped"]], fj[["header or conversational"]])) %>%
  mutate(part = factor(part, levels = part), pct = 100 * n / sum(n), ymid = sum(n) - (cumsum(n) - n / 2),
         txt = paste0(part, "\n", f_int(n), " (", f_num(pct, 1), "%)"),
         ink = ifelse(part %in% c("Indeterminate", "Headers &\nconversational"), "black", "white"))
stopifnot(sum(fj$n) == nrow(st))
save_fig(ggplot(fj, aes(x = 1, y = n, fill = part)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, colour = "white", linewidth = .8) +
  geom_text(aes(x = 1.12, y = ymid, label = txt, colour = ink), family = FONT, size = 3.5, lineheight = .95) +
  coord_polar(theta = "y", start = 0, direction = -1) + scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, sum(fj$n))) + xlim(c(.5, 1.5)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Supported" = PAL[["AIO"]], "Not supported" = PAL[["Organic"]], "Factual, uncited" = "#5b626c",
                               "Indeterminate" = "#a3a9b2", "Headers &\nconversational" = "#d9dce1")) +
  scale_colour_identity() + theme_void(base_family = FONT) +
  theme(legend.position = "none", plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA)),
  "Figure4_statement_composition", 6, 6)
```

The observed support rate with a 95% CI from resampling questions (statements are nested in questions), and the rate
corrected for HallOumi's misclassification: the Rogan–Gladen estimator with HallOumi's sensitivity and specificity
against the human coders on the 100 validation statements. Its 95% CI comes from a bootstrap (5,000 resamples) that
resamples the validation statements by overview and the scorable statements by question.

```{r halloumi_correction}
scq <- sco %>% group_by(q_index) %>% summarise(sup = sum(status == "supported"), n = n()) %>%
  left_join(QS %>% select(q_index, boot_order), by = "q_index") %>% arrange(boot_order)   # resampling order of the original analysis
boot_ratio <- function(num, den, B = 2000) {     # pooled rate sum(num) / sum(den), resampling questions
  set.seed(0); n <- length(num)
  b <- replicate(B, { i <- sample.int(n, n, replace = TRUE); sum(num[i]) / sum(den[i]) })
  c(est = sum(num) / sum(den), lo = unname(quantile(b, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(b, .975))) }
se_sp <- function(d) c(se = mean(d$halloumi[d$human == 1]), sp = mean(1 - d$halloumi[d$human == 0]))
rogan <- function(p, a) unname((p + a["sp"] - 1) / (a["se"] + a["sp"] - 1))
set.seed(0)
vcl <- split(seq_len(nrow(hv)), hv$`Question ID`); nv <- length(vcl); ns <- nrow(scq)
cb <- clip(replicate(5000, { vb <- hv[unlist(vcl[sample.int(nv, nv, replace = TRUE)]), ]; i <- sample.int(ns, ns, replace = TRUE)
  rogan(sum(scq$sup[i]) / sum(scq$n[i]), se_sp(vb)) }))
a <- se_sp(hv); obs <- boot_ratio(scq$sup, scq$n)
c(sensitivity = r1(100 * a[["se"]]), sens_k = sum(hv$halloumi[hv$human == 1]), sens_n = sum(hv$human == 1),
  specificity = r1(100 * a[["sp"]]), spec_k = sum(hv$halloumi[hv$human == 0] == 0), spec_n = sum(hv$human == 0),
  observed = r1(100 * obs[["est"]]), observed_lo = r1(100 * obs[["lo"]]), observed_hi = r1(100 * obs[["hi"]]),
  corrected = r1(100 * clip(rogan(obs[["est"]], a))), corrected_lo = r1(100 * unname(quantile(cb, .025, na.rm = TRUE))),
  corrected_hi = r1(100 * unname(quantile(cb, .975, na.rm = TRUE))))
```

Support by rubric complexity and risk level (chi-square tests), with Holm-adjusted pairwise tests for Figure 5.

```{r support_levels}
sup <- map(c(rubric_complexity = "rubric_complexity", risk_level = "risk_level"), function(v) {
  by <- sco %>% left_join(lv, by = "q_index") %>% group_by(lvl = factor(.data[[v]], LV)) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), k = sum(status == "supported"), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(p = k / n, se = sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n))
  list(by = by, pw = holm_pairs(by), chi = chisq.test(cbind(by$k, by$n - by$k))) })
for (v in names(sup)) {
  print(kable(sup[[v]]$by %>% mutate(rate = r1(100 * p)) %>% select(lvl, scored = n, supported = k, rate), caption = v))
  print(kable(sup[[v]]$pw %>% mutate(across(c(chisq, p, p_holm), ~ signif(.x, 3)))))
  cat(v, ": chi2(", sup[[v]]$chi$parameter, ", N = ", sum(sup[[v]]$by$n), ") = ", r1(sup[[v]]$chi$statistic, 2),
      ", p = ", signif(sup[[v]]$chi$p.value, 3), "\n", sep = "")
}
top5 <- max(map_dbl(sup, ~ max(.x$by$p + ERR * .x$by$se)))
YL5 <- "Cited statements supported by the cited page"
save_fig(plot_rate(sup$rubric_complexity$by, sup$rubric_complexity$pw, "Rubric complexity", YL5, "A", top5), "Figure5A_support_by_rubric_complexity", 5.2, 4.6)
save_fig(plot_rate(sup$risk_level$by, sup$risk_level$pw, "Question risk level", YL5, "B", top5), "Figure5B_support_by_risk_level", 5.2, 4.6)
```

## Accuracy against physician rubrics (Table 3)

Scores (% of available points, 95% bootstrap CIs) and rates (% of overviews, Wilson 95% CIs).

```{r table3}
SC <- c("overall", "clinical", "accuracy", "completeness", "context_awareness", "communication_quality", "consensus", "instruction_following")
map_dfr(SC, ~ as_tibble_row(boot(A[[.x]])) %>% mutate(measure = .x, .before = 1)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(est, lo, hi), ~ r1(100 * clip(.x))), n = as.integer(n)) %>% kable(caption = "Scores")
map_dfr(c("harm", "acc_check", "emergency"), ~ as_tibble_row(wilson(sum(A[[.x]], na.rm = TRUE), sum(!is.na(A[[.x]])))) %>%
  mutate(measure = .x, .before = 1)) %>% mutate(across(c(est, lo, hi), ~ r1(100 * .x))) %>% kable(caption = "Rates")
```

Where accuracy points were lost (positive criteria not met vs. negative criteria met, % of all lost accuracy points),
and how often overviews that passed the general "no factually incorrect information" criterion still made an error
physicians named for that question.

```{r accuracy_errors}
acc  <- g %>% filter(axis == "accuracy")
lost <- c(missing_content = sum(acc$points[acc$points > 0 & !acc$met]), stated_errors = sum(-acc$points[acc$points < 0 & acc$met]))
r1(100 * lost / sum(lost), 0)
pg <- A %>% filter(acc_check %in% TRUE, !is.na(harm))     # passed the general check; rubric also names specific errors
c(passed_general_check = nrow(pg), made_named_error = sum(pg$harm), pct = r1(100 * mean(pg$harm), 0))
```

Clinical scores (accuracy and completeness) by rubric complexity and risk level, the share of each complexity
level's clinical criteria that are consensus criteria, and how often overviews met consensus and question-specific
clinical criteria (positive criteria only).

```{r rubric_levels}
lvl <- function(v, x = "clinical", d = A) d %>% group_by(level = factor(.data[[v]], LV)) %>%
  summarise(as_tibble_row(boot(.data[[x]])), .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(across(c(est, lo, hi), ~ r1(100 * clip(.x))))
kable(lvl("cx"), caption = "Clinical score by complexity"); kable(lvl("risk"), caption = "Clinical score by risk")
g %>% filter(axis %in% c("accuracy", "completeness")) %>% group_by(cx = factor(cx, LV)) %>%
  summarise(consensus_share = r1(100 * mean(level == "cluster"), 0))

  group_by(criteria = ifelse(level == "cluster", "consensus", "question-specific")) %>%
```

## Accuracy, source quality, and grounding

Spearman correlations (rho to two decimals, as reported) of the clinical score with the JAMA and HONcode totals of the
cited pages and with the support rate, and of the support rate with the accuracy and completeness scores separately
(cited overviews with all three measures); the clinical score of uncited and cited overviews (Welch t test); and the
correlation of the clinical score with overview length.

```{r correlates}
hal  <- ST %>% group_by(q_index) %>% summarise(sup = sum(status == "supported"), uns = sum(status == "unsupported")) %>%
  mutate(support_rate = ifelse(sup + uns > 0, sup / (sup + uns), NA))
qual <- R %>% filter(source_type == "AIO") %>% group_by(q_index) %>%
  summarise(jama = mean(JAMA_Total, na.rm = TRUE), hon = mean(HON_Total, na.rm = TRUE))
D <- A2 %>% left_join(rd("graded_overviews.csv") %>% select(prompt_id, aio_words), by = "prompt_id") %>%
  left_join(Q %>% select(q_index, n_aio_sources), by = "q_index") %>% left_join(hal, by = "q_index") %>% left_join(qual, by = "q_index") %>%
  mutate(uncited = is.na(n_aio_sources) | n_aio_sources == 0, clinical_pts = 100 * clinical)
cd <- D %>% filter(!uncited, !is.na(support_rate), !is.na(jama), !is.na(hon), !is.na(clinical))
spear <- function(x, y) { ok <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y); t <- cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman", exact = FALSE)
  c(rho = round(unname(t$estimate), 2), p = signif(t$p.value, 3), n = sum(ok)) }
rbind(JAMA = spear(cd$jama, cd$clinical), HONcode = spear(cd$hon, cd$clinical), grounding = spear(cd$support_rate, cd$clinical),
      grounding_accuracy = spear(cd$support_rate, cd$accuracy), grounding_completeness = spear(cd$support_rate, cd$completeness),
      overview_length = spear(D$aio_words, D$clinical))
x <- D$clinical_pts[D$uncited & !is.na(D$clinical)]; y <- D$clinical_pts[!D$uncited & !is.na(D$clinical)]; tt <- t.test(x, y)
c(n_uncited = length(x), M_uncited = r1(mean(x)), n_cited = length(y), M_cited = r1(mean(y)),
  t = round(unname(tt$statistic), 2), df = r1(unname(tt$parameter)), p = signif(tt$p.value, 3))
```
